command: Use config/qwen2_1p5b_target_shape.json as the only shape authority. Generate deterministic operation-order vectors and compare all 1536 outputs; do not normalize chunks independently. Then define the restartable RMSNorm/QKV target segment receipt: frozen input/norm hashes, Q/K/V matrix shape and weight hashes, QKV bias hashes, exact physical array-step counters and output hashes. Payload and trace/count evidence must remain separately labeled.

final residual and target-shape cycle report
success_condition: Every target-shape payload segment consumes and emits frozen hashes, all intermediate nodes agree with the operation-order model, QKV bias and GQA mapping are exercised, no score matrix is materialized, and full trace/count cycles are explicitly separated from segmented payload numerics; CPU 8-25, max j4 and 10 GiB cap remain enforced.
